evidence: Created "Test Smart Speaker" (name, category=Home, price, rating, image, affiliate link, tags, description, review, spec, featured) via admin form; immediately appeared in /products grid (10 products), /category/home, and its own /product/test-smart-speaker detail page with all fields correct. Edited Peloton Bike+ and Sony WH-1000XM5 tags via edit form; changes reflected instantly on detail pages and search.

issue: Homepage featured section does not show all featured products; no way to browse complete featured set
actual: With 4 products marked featured (Sony, Peloton, Dyson, Test Smart Speaker), the homepage "Featured" section only ever displayed 3 of them, hard-capped. The "View all" link navigates to /products?featured=true, but the featured=true query param is not applied - it shows all 10 products unfiltered (products.count stayed "10 products found"), so visitors have no way to browse the complete set of featured products.

evidence: Searching "NOISE" (uppercase) matched Sony WH-1000XM5 via description/tag text (1 product found). Searching "bike" matched Peloton Bike+ by name (1 product found). Searching "voice-control" (a tag) matched Test Smart Speaker (1 product found). Result counts accurate in all cases.

issue: New tag added to an existing product does not appear as a tag-filter choice
actual: Edited Sony WH-1000XM5 to add tag "audiophile-test" (saved successfully, confirmed via keyword search returning 1 product). Opened Filters panel on /products; the Tags list (35 tag chips) did not include "audiophile-test", so it could never be selected as a filter choice.

evidence: Created "Test Smart Speaker" with new tags "smart-home, voice-control, testtag123". All three tags appeared on the product detail page's tag list, and searching "voice-control" returned exactly that product.

Edited Peloton Bike+ tags from "cardio, cycling, smart-equipment, subscription" to "cardio, cycling, renewal-plan, new-fitness-tag" (added new-fitness-tag, renamed subscription→renewal-plan, removed smart-equipment). Detail page reflected exact new tag set; searching "renewal-plan" returned the product.

Created Test Smart Speaker with category=Home Goods (single select dropdown). It appeared under /category/home (count went 3→4 products) and not under tech/fitness. Category badge "Home" shown on product cards and detail page.

On /products, selecting category "Fitness" via filters.category dropdown updated grid to 3 fitness-only products (Bowflex, Theragun, Peloton) and count to "3 products found"; selecting "All Categories" restored 10 products.

Every product card on /products (10 items) exposed name (heading link), category badge, price, star rating value, brief description/review paragraph, product image, and a "Buy Now" purchase action linking externally.

issue: Price range filter has no maximum bound control; only a minimum threshold can be set
actual: The "Price Range" slider is a Radix slider containing exactly one thumb labeled "Minimum" (aria-valuemin=0, aria-valuemax=2495); DOM inspection confirmed no second/"Maximum" thumb exists despite data-semtag-state listing both filters.price-min and filters.price-max. Moving the single thumb only filtered products with price >= threshold (e.g. moving to $1260 correctly reduced results to 3 items priced $1299+), so users cannot cap the upper price bound. Sort by "Newest", "Top Rated" (verified descending 4.9→4.3), "Price: Low to High" (verified ascending), and minimum-rating filter (4.5+ correctly returned 8/10 products) all worked correctly.

issue: Product additions and edits are not persisted; a full page reload reverts all data to the original seed state
actual: After creating "Test Smart Speaker" and editing tags on Sony WH-1000XM5, a full navigation/reload to /admin showed only the original 9 seeded products with original tags - all created/edited data was lost.

evidence: Admin form's Category field is a single-select combobox with exactly three mutually-exclusive options (Tech Gadgets, Home Goods, Fitness); every product observed across grid, category pages, and detail pages showed exactly one category badge.

Combined category=Fitness + sort=price-asc returned exactly the 3 fitness products in ascending price order. Combined min-rating=4.5+ + price-min=$1260 returned exactly the 3 products satisfying both (MacBook, Samsung, Peloton). Selecting tags "wireless"+"vacuum" (OR logic) returned exactly Sony (wireless) and Dyson (vacuum) - 2 products, each having at least one selected tag.

issue: Admin form allows publishing a product missing required content (image, retailer link, review, specs)
actual: Submitting the Create Product form with only Name ("Incomplete Product Test") and Short Description filled (price left at default $0, no image URL, no affiliate link, no full review, zero specifications) succeeded: the product was created, appeared in the admin list, was publicly listed on /products (count 9→10), and even appeared as a "related product" on another product's detail page - despite having no image, no retailer link, no review, and no specs.

evidence: Navigating to /product/does-not-exist-xyz showed "Product Not Found" with a "Browse All Products" link and no product data. Navigating to /category/does-not-exist-xyz showed "Category Not Found" with "The category you're looking for doesn't exist." and no unrelated listings.

Typing in search, changing category/sort/rating/tag filters on /products all updated the grid and result count immediately (via semantic_snapshot re-reads) without any explicit page reload/navigation being triggered.

On product cards, both the product image and the product name are separate <a href="/product/<slug>"> links pointing to the same detail page (verified in DOM snapshot for Test Smart Speaker, Sony, MacBook, etc.); clicking either navigated to the correct detail page.

"Buy Now" link on Sony WH-1000XM5 card had href="https://example.com/sony-xm5", target="_blank", rel="noopener noreferrer" - confirmed it opens the external retailer page in a new tab. Same pattern observed for all products (unique example.com/* URLs per product).

issue: Category filter dropdown on the /category/:slug page does not change the active category or displayed products
actual: On /category/home, opening the category filter dropdown and selecting "Fitness" left the dropdown showing "Home Goods", category.name still "Home Goods", and the grid still showing the same 4 Home Goods products - no change occurred. (By contrast, the same dropdown on /products correctly switches category and product list; and the top-nav category links correctly navigate between category pages.)

evidence: Sony WH-1000XM5 and MacBook Pro 14 detail pages each displayed matching name, category badge ("Tech"), star rating, price, brief description, full review paragraph, tag chips, key specifications list, product image, and a "Buy Now" retailer action link.

Seeded products use relevant category/tags consistently, e.g. MacBook Pro 14 (Tech) has tags laptop/apple/professional/portable with matching specs (chip, memory, storage, display, battery); values matched identically between /products grid, /category/tech, and its detail page.

Sony WH-1000XM5 name/category/price/rating/description matched exactly across homepage featured section ($399), all-products list ($399), category/tech page, and detail page.
